name: clipboard
title: Clipboard
description: Copy text to the clipboard, with a temporary confirmation state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description:
The initial value to be copied to the clipboard when rendered.
Use when you don't need to control the value of the clipboard.

props.name: getRootNode
props.description: A root node to correctly resolve document in custom environments. E.x.: Iframes, Electron.

props.name: ids
props.description: The ids of the elements in the clipboard. Useful for composition.

props.name: timeout
props.description: The timeout for the copy operation

props.name: translations
props.description: Specifies the localized strings that identifies the accessibility elements and their states

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value of the clipboard

events.name: onStatusChange
events.description: The function to be called when the value is copied to the clipboard

events.name: onValueChange
events.description: The function to be called when the value changes

examples.title: Basic
examples.source:
import Clipboard from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/clipboard/clipboard.marko";

<Clipboard label="Link" defaultValue="https://example.com" class="w-[400px]"/>
examples.description: A labeled clipboard field. Click the trigger to copy the value.

examples.title: Custom timeout
examples.source:
import Clipboard from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/clipboard/clipboard.marko";

<Clipboard label="Coupon code" value="MARKO-UI-2026" timeout=1000 class="w-[400px]"/>
examples.description: Pass `timeout` to control how long the copied confirmation state is shown, in milliseconds.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.source:
import Clipboard from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/clipboard/clipboard.marko";

<Clipboard label="Link" value="https://example.com" disabled class="w-[400px]"/>
examples.description: A disabled clipboard is skipped by the tab order and ignores pointer input.

examples.title: Controlled
examples.source:
import Clipboard from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/clipboard/clipboard.marko";

Value: ${value}

{ value = next; } class="w-[400px]" />
examples.description: Zag machines are controlled: a `value` prop without a change handler never moves. Pair it with `valueChange`, or use Marko's bind shorthand `value:=state`.
